The '''Moobia system''' was located in the [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the item known as [[Moobian torsion valve/Legends|Moobian torsion valve]].<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Moobian torsion valve/Legends|Moobian torsion valve]]|system=Moobia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Moobia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square R-10.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
